title: Timothy J. Dyches
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Married Jill Elizabeth Dudley, 1974, in the Manti Utah Temple; Three children.
Bachelors in University Studies, BYU; MD, Washington University Medical School
Surgeon in Private Practice; Senior Management in national surgical management co.
Ward Clerk, SS President, High Councilor, Stake President's Counselor, Stake President, Area Seventy
Second Quorum of the Seventy, 2013 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
